blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Could stronger cooperation among Asean countries mean more affordable food, reliable electricity, better jobs, and greater opportunities for Filipino consumers? These were among the issues explored during the first day of the Asean Business and Investment Summit (ABIS) 2026 on Saturday, November 14, as business leaders, policymakers, and industry representatives discussed how Southeast Asia could strengthen its economy amid global uncertainty.
